_comment: Carry destination for #2952 (the three restoring jobs outside governance.yml
that ci_predict.py's graders arm does not key). No live roster group covers
#2952, so this file is its brief. Shape and required fields:
stage: #2952, predicting before the pull request the CI red of a branch that edits a program the briefs, pr-contract or budget-raise-gate job restores from the base

carries.from: #2925 (R10-RCA-PREPR-HEAD-GRADERS), fix review rounds 5 and 6: the graders arm narrowed to governance.yml's restoring jobs, the other three left open
carries.control: Enumeration rule: `git grep -n -- "- name: Restore the check source from the base commit" HEAD -- .github/workflows/` returned six jobs at #2925's head 3efeea217 and at origin/main 3042dcd4f alike: governance.yml policy-docs, env-matrix and wave-script, which `restore_jobs` keys (it is given governance.yml's text only), and budget-raise-gate.yml budget-raise-gate, pr-contract.yml pr-contract and tests.yml briefs, which it does not. The arm's null control is its own: `python3 -I tools/pr/ci_predict.py --self-test` prints `ci_predict self-test: 0 failed` on the unmutated tree, and `dev/audit/rca/prepr-head-graders/mutants.py` turns it red when `restored_hit` or `ci_tree_run` is broken. No instance of a red from these three jobs has been measured: #2925's section-4 census read the governance.yml jobs only, so the pr-contract and budget-raise-gate cases are unmeasured, not absent.
carries.remeasure: At your merge base, re-run the enumeration rule and take its job set, not the six above; re-read each job's restore pathspecs and the programs its later run steps invoke from the workflow, not from this carry. Before claiming the class closed, plant one edit per job (a branch whose head copy of the restored program differs from the base copy in a way that changes the verdict) and show the arm predicting it, with the unplanted tree as the null.
carries.brief: Widen the graders arm in `tools/pr/ci_predict.py` (`restore_jobs`, `grader_runs`, `ci_tree_run`) from governance.yml to every workflow job the enumeration rule returns, keyed on each job's own restore pathspecs, so a branch editing `brief_lint.mjs`, pr-contract's checkers (`policy_lint.mjs`, `figure_lint.mjs`, `preflight.sh`, `prepr.sh`, `carry_audit.py`) or `budget_raise_gate.py` is graded locally by the base copy as CI grades it. Precondition: `budget-raise-gate` reads live pull-request reviews, so a local run of it can only be partial; a prediction for it states which inputs it ran without, and is never reported as a pass. Refused: listing the three jobs by name, which closes the instance and not the class; the arm reads the workflows the enumeration returns.
